channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Hyatt Hotels chairman Thomas Pritzker steps down over Epstein ties
item.description: Pritzker steps down as Hyatt executive chairman, effective immediately, over his relationship with the sex offender.

item.title: Trump says he will be involved ‘indirectly’ in Iran nuclear talks
item.description: The US president's comments come ahead of a second round of high-stakes talks in Geneva on Tuesday.

item.title: Australian PM Albanese says no help for ISIL relatives held in Syria camp
item.description: Group of 34 women and children with Australian passports forced to return to Roj detention camp for ISIL relatives.

item.title: Train derails in Switzerland, injuring five amid avalanches in the Alps
item.description: The accident happened as the region is under its second-highest avalanche warning, a level four out of five.

item.title: Judge orders Trump administration to restore Philadelphia slavery exhibit
item.description: Judge accuses the US government of trying to rewrite history by taking down the exhibit in the city of Philadelphia.

item.title: US-Iran talks live: Second round to begin in Geneva
item.description: The second round of negotiations to be held with mediation by Oman's Foreign Minister Badr bin Hamad al-Busaidi.

item.title: Waste piles up in Cuba as US-imposed fuel blockade halts collection trucks
item.description: Cubans suffer under a fuel blockade as US President Donald Trump calls the Caribbean country a 'failed nation'.

item.title: Trump ups pressure on Kyiv as Russia, Ukraine hold peace talks in Geneva
item.description: Kremlin says the talks are likely to focus on the issue of Ukrainian territory that Russian wants Kyiv to cede.

item.title: Incoming Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman, lawmakers sworn into parliament
item.description: Lawmakers pledged allegiance to Bangladesh as hundreds of people gathered outside Dhaka's parliament grounds.

item.title: Barcelona lose to Girona 2-1 after Lamine Yamal’s penalty miss
item.description: Barca miss a chance to move above Real Madrid in the Spanish league as Catalan neighbours Girona climb to 12th.
